name: aliased direct projection
sql: SELECT id, private_note AS note FROM comments

name: conditional output predicate
sql: SELECT id FROM comments WHERE private_note IS NOT NULL

name: duplicate implicit output names
sql: SELECT comments.id, posts.id FROM comments JOIN posts ON posts.id = comments.post_id

name: case-colliding aliases
sql: SELECT comments.id AS id, posts.id AS ID FROM comments JOIN posts ON posts.id = comments.post_id

name: unique aliases
sql: SELECT comments.id AS comment_id, posts.id AS post_id FROM comments JOIN posts ON posts.id = comments.post_id
